GET /api/venture-scores/:projectId.note: The venture's founder, an accepted owner or co-founder, an Operating Partner or Admin (every venture, by D1256), or an advisor the founder shared it with (read-only, no analyst note) reads it. Another venture's founder, an advisor with no share or a share switched off, a removed co-founder, a roster advisor and an investor by venture id get 403 naming nothing; no credentials or a disabled founder get 401.

GET /api/venture-scores/:projectId/shari.note: Only the venture's founders (the founder entity, an accepted owner or co-founder) read who sees its scorecard. Operating Partners, Admins, the shared advisor, a removed co-founder and another venture's founder get 403 naming nothing.

GET /api/venture-scores/:projectId/traje.note: The venture's founders, Operating Partners and Admins read it; staff reads are logged. Any advisor, a removed co-founder, an investor and another venture's founder get 403 naming nothing.

POST /api/venture-scores/:projectId/corr.note: Only the venture's founders ask to correct an input; Operating Partners, Admins, the shared advisor, a removed co-founder, an investor and another venture's founder get 403 with a valid body, and no correction or log row is written.

POST /api/venture-scores/:projectId/reco.note: The venture's founders, Operating Partners and Admins re-score it; any advisor, a removed co-founder, an investor and another venture's founder get 403 and no score row is written.
